resources.string: Browse official hymn topics in English and Spanish and use them to plan music for each meeting.
Edit topics for your unit. Changes sync with the web app without changing other units or the official catalog.
Include one Christmas hymn per meeting, or generate Christmas-only or Easter-only selections. The sacrament hymn remains a sacrament hymn, and manual selections are preserved.
A more compact Library: open filters with one tap and expand topics when needed, leaving more room for hymns.
Pull down to refresh Agendas, Planning, and Hymn Planner. Hymn Planner also keeps its Refresh button for long lists.
Try another hymn combination from the preview. Your rules and manual selections are preserved; changes are saved only when you apply the plan.
